description: Traffico medio giornaliero - Sensori is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. La tavola riporta i flussi di traffico giornaliero medio (TMG) per alcune zone di Cesena, dal 2012 al 2015. - Il TGM esprime il numero medio di automezzi rilevato dai sensori di traffico attualmente installati e di futura attivazione (vedi planimetria generale). Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are mobilita, strade, veicolo, viabilita. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
